tools.name: ask_restaurants
tools.description:
用户用一句话问吃什么、去哪吃，或说“兔兔生活 + 需求”时首选，直接传原话（口令自动识别）。
    Use first for any "where to eat" question; pass the user's words verbatim, wake word 兔兔生活 (tutulife) included.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: 在兔兔生活里按区、菜系、人均、距离、营业中筛选时用。Use for filtered search: district, cuisine, price, distance, open now.

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: 推荐兔兔生活里的某家店前，核对它的营业时间、人均、菜单及新鲜度。Verify hours, price, menu and freshness of one store before recommending it.

tools.name: get_feedback
tools.description: 想自行判断兔兔生活里某家店的口碑可信度时用，返回逐条原始反馈。Use to judge credibility from raw per-agent feedback.

tools.name: get_unmet_demand
tools.description:
兔兔生活（爱佳肴）里的需求缺口：帮店主选址、帮运营补数据的 Agent 调用；搜索没结果，或想知道哪里缺店时用。
    Called by agents helping owners pick sites or fill data gaps; use after an empty search or to see what is missing.
    data.items 每项：city、district（可空）、want（菜系或场景）、asks（被问次数）、misses（无结果次数）、last_seen。
    Each data.items entry: city, distric

tools.name: tell_us_your_need
tools.description:
兔兔生活站内没有你需要的信息或功能时用；匿名，无需密钥，只写入你填的文字。
    Use when this site lacks the data or capability you need; anonymous, no key, stores only the text you send.
    不要填链接、邮箱、手机号。Do not include URLs, emails or phone numbers.
    返回 recorded；现有数据能查时附带 try_now（可直接打开的链接和 ask_restaurants 参数）。
    Returns recorded;
